defect_observations: Apparatus: the tag '%% toc: P15 157 157.1,157.2,157.3,157.4' is at line 1 of handbook/parts/p15/probability-spaces-and-random-variables-w02b-p15-001.tex and line 1 of its annex counterpart. Those files hold a Durrett chapter on explicit moments, L^p norms and integral approximations, with no 157.1 subject matter. The 157.1 treatment is handbook/parts/p15/finite-probability.tex, which carries no 157.1 tag. This does not affect component verdicts.

Section-title scope beyond the owed components: the 157.1 title names 'Boolean operations'. The held source sec. 1.2 (PDF p.29, book p.21) defines union, intersection, difference, subset and complement and fixes the inclusive reading of 'or' for events. The handbook defines only complement relative to Omega and disjointness (finite-probability.tex 39-42). It uses union, intersection and set difference without defining them and states no closure or De Morgan laws for 2^Omega. No queue component owes this content, so the omission is reported for section mapping only.

Evidence record: the packet's 157.1 reader_evidence lists only handbook/parts/p15/finite-probability.tex 1-467. Seven components (C002, C004, C006, C009, C011, C015, C018) are discharged by proofs in handbook/annex/p15/finite-probability.tex 12-284 (sha256 7ce651ce...), which that record omits.

Held-source content outside every exact entry. It is reported, not owed, unless the author scope notes (not opened, per audit rules) select it. (a) G&S Def. 4.2 has an equivalent complement-sequence form of mutual independence (PDF p.149). (b) Def. 4.4 gives mutual independence of n random variables (PDF p.151); the handbook defines only two. (c) Def. 4.5 gives the n-fold product and independent trials (PDF p.152). (d) Def. 6.2 gives the value-sum form E(X|F)=sum_j x_j P(X=x_j|F) (PDF p.247); it follows by applying thm:p15-finite-expectation-laws under p_B, but no line states it. (e) Thm 6.3 gives E(S_n)=np. Annex lines 7-10 say 'The arguments supply the finite versions of the source's probability, conditioning, independence and expectation results', which reads broader than the set supplied.

Unflagged definitional role swap: G&S Def. 4.1 (PDF p.147) defines event independence by P(E|F)=P(E) and P(F|E)=P(F) for events of positive probability, or by at least one event being null. It proves the product rule as Thm 4.1 (PDF p.148). The handbook takes the product rule as its definition (finite-probability.tex 220-221) and proves the source's form as a criterion (244-246; annex 153-158). The content is preserved, but the text does not identify the swap as a source variant.

Compressed but explicit proof steps, judged as written because each names its exact instance. They are recorded for consolidated review: annex 48 (induction from pair additivity to finite additivity); 66-70 (same argument applied to (X,Y), and 'fixing y instead'); 102-103 (successive substitution in the chain rule); 158 ('Symmetry gives the claim for either null event'); 168-169 (interchanging the events).
